script: # IMPORTANT: Scoop runs this uninstaller during `scoop update` as well as `scoop uninstall`,
# and it gives the script no way to tell the two apart. So this script must only remove
# recreatable resources (containers + networks) and must NOT touch persistent data — otherwise
# every `scoop update companion-hub` would wipe the user's database and app state.
# Containers and networks are recreated on next launch from the surviving volumes.
# Persistent Docker volumes (ci_hub_pgdata, ci_hub_app_data, hub_tailscale_state) and the
# %APPDATA%/%LOCALAPPDATA% state directories are deliberately preserved here. For a full data
# purge, run distribution/scripts/uninstall-cleanup.ps1 manually after uninstalling.
if (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
# Marketplace apps run as their own compose projects (<app>_<store>), tagged with
# ci-os-hub.managed=true. Remove their containers and networks only (NOT volumes) for the
# same update-safety reason as above — they are recreated from surviving data on next launch.

$managedProjects = docker ps -a --filter 'label=ci-os-hub.managed=true' --format '{{.Label "com.docker.compose.project"}}' 2>$null | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 } | Select-Object -Unique
foreach ($project in $managedProjects) {
if ($project -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$') { continue }
if ($project -in @('ci-os-hub','ci-hub')) { continue }  # Hub stack handled below
foreach ($cid in (docker ps -a --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$project" --format '{{.ID}}' 2>$null)) { if ($cid) { docker rm -f $cid 2>$null | Out-Null } }

foreach ($net in (docker network ls --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$project" --format '{{.Name}}' 2>$null)) { if ($net -and $net -notin @('bridge','host','none','ci_os_hub_network','ci-os-hub_network')) { docker network rm $net 2>$null | Out-Null } }
$containerNames = @()
$containerNames += docker ps -a --filter 'label=com.docker.compose.project=ci-os-hub' --format '{{.Names}}' 2>$null
$containerNames += docker ps -a --filter 'label=com.docker.compose.project=ci-hub' --format '{{.Names}}' 2>$null
$containerNames += docker ps -a --filter 'network=ci_os_hub_network' --format '{{.Names}}' 2>$null
$containerNames += docker ps -a --filter 'network=ci-os-hub_network' --format '{{.Names}}' 2>$null
$containerNames = $containerNames | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 } | Select-Object -Unique
foreach ($name in $containerNames) { docker rm -f $name 2>$null | Out-Null }
docker network rm ci_os_hub_network ci-os-hub_network 2>$null | Out-Null
